mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_record (order_id, payment_no, pay_channel, pay_amount, pay_status) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{paymentNo}, #{payChannel}, #{payAmount}, #{payStatus})
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.order_id AS orderId, p.payment_no AS paymentNo, p.pay_channel AS payChannel, p.pay_amount AS payAmount, p.pay_status AS payStatus, p.transaction_no AS transactionNo, p.paid_time AS paidTime FROM payment_record p WHERE p.payment_no = #{paymentNo}

SELECT p.id, p.order_id AS orderId, p.payment_no AS paymentNo, p.pay_channel AS payChannel, p.pay_amount AS payAmount, p.pay_status AS payStatus, p.transaction_no AS transactionNo, p.paid_time AS paidTime FROM payment_record p INNER JOIN orders o ON p.order_id = o.id WHERE p.payment_no = #{paymentNo} AND o.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_record SET pay_status = 1, paid_time = NOW(), transaction_no = CONCAT('MOCK-', payment_no) WHERE payment_no = #{paymentNo} AND pay_status = 0
